title: Belfast Entries Project Phase 2 was completed
summary: Belfast City Council's 2023-24 performance report recorded completion of Phase 2 of the Belfast Entries Project; the council project page identifies College Street Mews, High Street Entry, Patterson's Place and Sugarhouse Entry as the Phase 2 entries and describes maintenance, artwork, lighting, interpretive signage and paving works.
observed_change: A second group of city-centre entries had completed public-realm, lighting, interpretive-signage and paving works during the 2023-24 reporting year.
area: College Street Mews / High Street Entry / Patterson's Place / Sugarhouse Entry, Belfast city centre
source_date_field: 2023-24 corporate-performance completion statement; report published September 2024
architect: Belfast City Council, AECOM, Daisy Chain Inc, Form Native, and Belfast Entries project team
geometry_source: Approximate midpoint curated from the named Phase 2 city-centre entries; Belfast City Council project page supplies named entries but not a GIS boundary.
geometry_precision: Approximate multi-site midpoint, not a measured public-realm boundary or individual entry footprint.
limitations: The performance report gives fiscal-year completion rather than a day-level opening date. Sugarhouse Entry is already represented as a separate reopening event, so this candidate should be reviewed as a broader Phase 2 public-realm completion and not double-counted as a second Sugarhouse-only milestone.
